decision.observation: The goose stands by the gate's right post. The latch is clearly a vertical sliding bolt on the post's inner face: an upper elbow handle at ~(0.525, 0.337) and a lower elbow handle at ~(0.561, 0.488), the latter right beside the goose's beak. The white plate stays behind the left rails.
decision.hypothesis: The vertical bolt must slide upward to unlatch; a drag starting exactly on the lower elbow and pulling straight up may slide it and swing the gate open.
decision.memory: Untried variant: strictly vertical upward drag from the lower elbow handle.
